title: The Tale of Qingyao
next_chapter_hook: Su Qingyao pressed a formation eye glowing with faint azure light into Chen Ji's palm, whispering, "The killing formation set up by the three great sects for the finals three days from now is far more than what meets your eye... I will be waiting for you within the formation."

text.content: Night wind swept through the dilapidated side hall, causing the candle flames to flicker uncertainly. Su Qingyao's fingertips still trembled slightly, and on that face usually cold as ice, a rare hint of vulnerability appeared. Chen Ji watched her quietly, his gaze deep as an abyss, yet his mind was rapidly calculating—was this daughter of his father's old friend? Was this identity real or false?

dialogue.content: "I know what you're thinking." Su Qingyao took a deep breath, her voice hoarse. "You think this is just another excuse to get close to you. But do you know, among the inheritors of the Tianji Record, there exists a certain... bond?"

text.content: Before her words could finish, Su Qingyao suddenly closed her eyes, her slender fingers gently pressing against her brow center. In the next instant, Chen Ji felt a burning sensation in his chest—the location of the Tianji Record Fragment. His pupils contracted sharply as he saw an arcane pattern faintly emerging at Su Qingyao's brow center, identical to the one on his own chest!

dialogue.content: "This is..." Her voice trembled. "The Inheritance Mark. Every generation of Tianji Record holders awakens it. And I, though I don't possess the Tianji Record itself, due to my father, have gained the ability to sense your condition."

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly recalled that over these years, whenever he used the Tianji Record's Foresight Ability, there was always a faint, intangible gaze watching from the shadows. He had always thought it was an illusion, but now that he thought about it... "When did you start watching me?" His tone cooled. "From the day I entered the Tianqing Sect?"

dialogue.content: "Not watching, protecting." Su Qingyao's eyes snapped open, the corners slightly reddened. "Your father Chen Xuan, in the year I turned seven, had already foreseen—that you would encounter a catastrophe capable of destroying the entire Chen family. He transferred part of the Tianji Record Fragment's sensing ability to me, only asking that I protect you from the shadows."

text.content: Silence descended upon the side hall like death. Chen Ji lowered his gaze, hiding the churning emotions in his eyes. That man, the one in his memories who was always taciturn and never fulfilled his paternal duties, had actually begun making arrangements before Chen Ji was even born? The burning sensation in his chest gradually subsided, replaced by an indescribable bittersweet ache.

dialogue.content: "Thirteen years." Su Qingyao's voice was very soft. "Every time you were on the brink of death, I could sense that desperate feeling of near-death. Three years ago when you were surrounded by demonic beasts at the Back Mountain, last year when someone framed you at the Scripture Library... How do you think those close calls were resolved?"

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, his gaze sharp as a blade piercing toward Su Qingyao. "It was you?" His voice was low. "Those people who acted in the shadows..." Su Qingyao gave a bitter smile: "I killed three, crippled five. As for the rest... I'm keeping a tab." At that moment, a certain taut string in Chen Ji's heart quietly loosened by a fraction.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao confesses to thirteen years of protection. How should Chen Ji respond to this heavy affection?

choices.description: Since his father had already made arrangements, Su Qingyao is someone trustworthy. Accept her protection, and also accept this late-arriving... warmth of family.
choices.visible_reward: Gain deep trust from Su Qingyao, unlock prerequisites for "Shared Fate"
choices.risk_hint: If she still has secrets, everything could be lost

dialogue.content: Chen Ji..." Su Qingyao was stunned, and in those usually cold eyes, crystalline moisture actually glistened. Thirteen years of restraint and vigil seemed to finally have meaning at this moment.

text.content: Chen Ji let out a soft sigh and took out the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest. "Since a bond exists between us, this thing..." He paused. "Perhaps you can understand it." The arcane patterns on the Fragment responded to the mark at Su Qingyao's brow center, emitting a faint glow.

choices.description: Father's arrangements are not necessarily ironclad evidence. Chen Ji decides to accept partially while secretly probing her true stance.
choices.visible_cost: Might miss a prime opportunity for alliance
choices.visible_reward: Retain hidden cards while gaining partial intelligence
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao might feel hurt by the lack of trust

dialogue.content: A trace of gloom flickered in Su Qingyao's eyes, but she quickly restored her calm. "I understand." Her voice was soft. "If it were me, I wouldn't believe easily either. But time will prove everything."

text.content: She took out a Jade Slip from her sleeve and gently placed it on the table. "This contains information I've gathered over the years—about Ling Yuan, about the Xuanwu Sect, about... the truth on the day your father disappeared. Take a look first. If you have questions, come find me anytime."

choices.description: Don't dwell on trust issues, cooperate directly through interest exchange. Each takes what it needs, neither suffers loss.
choices.visible_reward: Gain key intelligence and crucial items for breaking the tournament formation
choices.risk_hint: Pure interest-based relationship may lack deep bonds

dialogue.content: "Interesting." A slight smile curved Su Qingyao's lips, and her gaze toward Chen Ji held more appreciation. "You're indeed much more shrewd than the rumored waste..."

text.content: She took out a formation eye glowing with faint azure light from her chest and placed it before Chen Ji. "This is the formation core of the tournament killing formation jointly arranged by the three sects. With it, you can discern every trace of the formation's operation." She paused, then added, "Of course, as an exchange—I want to know the prophecy about me within the Tianji Record Fragment."

Su Qingyao stared quietly at Chen Ji, her eyes reflecting the swaying candlelight and also reflecting some indescribable emotions. "Regardless of which method you choose," she suddenly spoke, "there is one thing I must tell you—the tournament killing formation is far more dangerous than you imagine. Ling Yuan... he will strike at you within the formation."

dialogue.content: "I shouldn't have said any of this." Her voice was pressed very low. "But since fate brought us together in this side hall... Chen Ji, you must be careful during the tournament. I will provide support from the shadows, but Ling Yuan is crafty and experienced. I don't have absolute confidence in protecting you."

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed softly. "Senior Sister Su, you've protected me for thirteen years, and now you want to fight side by side with me?" He raised his eyes, his gaze sharp. "This account won't be easy to settle." Su Qingyao was stunned, then also laughed—that smile carried relief, anticipation, and even a deeper meaning others couldn't comprehend.

choice.prompt: Faced with Su Qingyao's sincerity and the dangerous tournament battle ahead, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Take the formation eye from Su Qingyao's hand, promise to fight side by side in the tournament. The rare alliance between the waste and the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow will surely shock all three sects.
choices.visible_reward: Gain crucial items for breaking the tournament formation + Su Qingyao's covert support
choices.risk_hint: If the alliance is exposed, both will become targets of public criticism

text.content: Chen Ji extended his hand and took the azure formation eye. The moment it touched his palm, a cool sensation seeped into his heart, as if a hidden thread had quietly connected him and Su Qingyao. He raised his eyes to look at her and nodded solemnly: "Three days later, see you in the formation."

dialogue.content: A brilliant light flashed in Su Qingyao's eyes. She extended her hand and gently clasped Chen Ji's. "Thirteen years," her voice slightly choked, "I can finally stand by your side openly, instead of watching alone from the shadows." Candlelight swayed, casting their intertwined shadows on the mottled walls, merging into a single whole.

choices.description: Cooperation is possible, but Chen Ji needs more chips. He proposes a condition: Su Qingyao must help investigate the truth about his father's disappearance that day.
choices.visible_reward: Gain important clues for investigating the truth about his father
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao might feel you're using her

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's brow slightly raised, and her gaze toward Chen Ji held more scrutiny. "You want to investigate the truth about Chen Xuan's disappearance?" She mused for a moment. "This matter... does indeed relate to Ling Yuan. But now is not the time to speak of it."

text.content: She took out a yellowed paper from her sleeve and handed it to Chen Ji. "This is the last clue left by Chen Xuan before his disappearance—'At the end of Heavenly Secrets, see the true heart.' I've meditated on it for thirteen years but couldn't penetrate its meaning. Perhaps... you can understand."

Suddenly, footsteps sounded outside the side hall. Su Qingyao's expression changed, and she quickly concealed all her emotions. She stepped back two paces, restoring her cold and aloof appearance as Inner Disciple Senior Fellow. "Remember," her voice pressed extremely low, "in front of others, we are still strangers who don't recognize each other." As her words fell, she had already fled toward the door like a startled swan.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji." Su Qingyao paused at the doorway, her back to him. "Whether you believe me or not... I will not let anyone harm you. This is what I owe Chen Xuan, and also... what I do willingly." With that, she pushed open the door and left, leaving only a room of cold moonlight.

text.content: Chen Ji stood alone before the window, his fingers rubbing the azure formation eye in his hand. Moonlight fell, casting half his face pale as paper. Thirteen years of secret protection, thirteen years of restraint and sacrifice... How much of an unseen burden had this woman borne? And what grand chess game had that father he never met arranged from the shadows?

He slowly unfolded his palm, and the patterns on the formation eye responded to the Tianji Record Fragment. In a daze, he seemed to sense Su Qingyao's heartbeat at this moment—steady, powerful, yet harboring indescribable忐忑. The tournament three days later, Ling Yuan's killing formation, the secrets of the Tianji Record... all clues pointed in the same direction. Chen Ji's gaze sank, and a meaningful arc curved his lips. Waste? Heh, then let the entire world see how atrash turns the tide!

Su Qingyao pressed a formation eye glowing with faint azure light into Chen Ji's palm, whispering, "The killing formation set up by the three great sects for the finals three days from now is far more than what meets your eye... I will be waiting for you within the formation." Night wind stirred the loose hair at her temples, and on that cold and beautiful face, a gentleness never shown to others actually appeared. Thirteen years of vigil finally condensed at this moment into a promise to fight side by side.
